laws.heading: Lei 12.155/2023
laws.rule: Mato Grosso state Lei 12.155 of 19 June 2023 bans selling, storing, transporting, handling, using and letting off loud-bang fireworks and any noisy pyrotechnic device across the state, indoors or outdoors, on public or private land. Sight-only fireworks (visual effect, no bang) are excepted. Cargo passing through from another state to a third is allowed if it is not stored in Mato Grosso, even briefly.
laws.penalty_signal: fine of 200 to 3,000 UPF/MT; doubled on the first repeat and quadrupled from the second (a repeat means the same breach within 30 days)
